cohort: 9392 women with low-risk pregnancies at Stavanger University Hospital, Norway, from 2009 to 2015, including women of non-Western origin and ethnic Norwegian women
finding: Even in a low-risk population, women originating from Asia and Africa had an elevated risk of adverse pregnancy outcome compared to the Norwegian group.
mod_finding: Women originating from Asia and Africa had an elevated risk of emergency cesarean section compared to the Norwegian group.
